entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support! Get me support now!
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, listen up because I'm only saying this once. I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor and I need a full refund. I've had it with this company's policies.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Sterling, order number is VF772910. And don't give me any runaround about being outside a window. I've been a little preoccupied.

Okay, Mr. Sterling, I see your order from December 15th. I can definitely help you with this. So I can understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
The issue is I was in the hospital! I had an emergency surgery and I've been recovering. I didn't have time to call you people within your ridiculous 10 or 20-day window, or whatever it is.
I'm very sorry to hear that, sir. I hope you're recovering well. I just need to understand if the device itself is malfunctioning or if you simply decided you don't want it?

It doesn't matter! I don't want it! The doctor told me after the surgery that this kind of training is out for at least six months. This was all supposed to be prep for a military deployment, and now that's even up in the air. So are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager and plaster this all over your social media?

There's no need for that, Mr. Sterling. I can resolve this for you right now. I completely understand your situation with the unexpected hospital visit and surgery. Let me just quickly check the policy for your specific product.
You do that. And it better be the answer I want to hear.

Okay, I've just pulled it up. It looks like you're in luck. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor, the model you purchased, actually falls under our 90-day return policy. Since you received it 24 days ago, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. The stricter policies you mentioned don't apply to this particular item.
Oh. So... it's within the 90 days? You're sure?

Yes, absolutely. No exception is needed. I can process this return for you immediately. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on file right now. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed.
Well... okay. That's... good. I appreciate that, Isaac. Sorry for being aggressive, it's just been a stressful time dealing with everything after the emergency.
Not a problem at all, Mr. Sterling. I completely understand. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you.
You're very welcome. We wish you a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
